Gautam Singaraju, Ph.D.

Contact (obfuscated): gautam.singaraju @ gmail.com

SUMMARY
Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer at ServiceNow. Builds production systems for conversational and agentic AI: evaluation and runtime infrastructure, plus Now Assist summarization and reply recommendation. Previously Consulting Member of Technical Staff at Oracle; owned the machine-learning train-and-serve platform for Oracle Digital Assistant. Inventor on 16 granted U.S. patents in conversational machine learning.

EXPERIENCE
ServiceNow — Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer — June 2021–present
- Owned conversation generation for Agentic AI (https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/intelligent-experiences/generate-conversations.html), built agentic evaluations (https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/intelligent-experiences/agentic-evals.html) and the Agentic AI Harness at Moveworks, and shipped Now Assist case summarization, chat summarization, and reply recommendation as production features. Cited in the Wall Street Journal and on a ServiceNow earnings call (Pro Plus).

Oracle — Consulting Member of Technical Staff, Oracle Digital Assistant — February 2016–June 2021
- Owned the production ML train-and-serve platform: intent classification, none-class detection, quality reporting, knowledge graphs, and explainability; documented in product documentation and granted patents.

GE Software — Senior Architect — October 2014–January 2016
- Built big-data analytics for industrial systems.

Electronic Arts — Software Engineering Lead, EADP — March 2012–October 2014
- Built analytics for large-scale games.

Ask.com — Senior Software Engineer — June 2010–March 2012
- Built search analytics.

University of North Carolina at Charlotte — Postdoctoral researcher — August 2009–May 2010
- Analyzed botnets and domain reputation.
